queue.title: US 30-Year Yields Return to 2002 High
queue.resumo: US Treasuries resumed their retreat, lifting the 30-year yield back to its highest since 2002 as climbing oil prices raised concern about faster inflation and more central bank interest-rate increases. Vishal Khanduja, Head of Broad Markets Fixed Income at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, discusses credit spreads and whether or not yields will soon peak. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Stocks, Bonds Fall on Inflation Worry as Oil Rises
queue.resumo: A record-breaking run in stocks hit a wall as higher oil prices lifted bond yields, stoking concerns that potential inflationary pressures could trigger Federal Reserve rate hikes. Chuck Clough, Chairman at Clough Capital, discusses what he's seeing in current markets and whether we're facing an AI bubble. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: FTC, USDA Seek Comment on Farm Equipment Market Practices
queue.resumo: The Federal Trade Commission and the US Department of Agriculture launched an inquiry into the agricultural equipment market, including potential anticompetitive conduct.

queue.title: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
queue.resumo: The Survey of Consumer Expectations indicated that the median outlook for inflation over the next 12 months rose to 3.9%.
